subject: Runtime hiring plan + comp band review (Q4 commit)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Runtime hiring plan + comp band review (Q4 commit)

Team —

Following our capacity planning sync, I’m proposing the following hires to unblock delivery on the runtime roadmap and the Dedicated expansion work we committed to for Q1:

Proposed hires (headcount request: 3)
- 2 x Senior Runtime Engineers (individual contributor, infra/runtime focus) — comp band target: L5 (band 5)
- 1 x Reliability Engineering Lead (tech lead/IC3) — comp band target: L6 (band 6)

Rationale
- We have two feature rollouts that require low-latency kernel work + KV-cache refactor. One senior engineer per kernel stream keeps us parallelized.
- The Reliability Lead will drive SLOs, on-call rework, and the Dedicated autoscaling policy integration.

Budget / funding
- Hiring will be charged to the Runtime Q4 reserve (capex reallocation approved in last finance sync).
- We expect blended fully-loaded cost to fit the current headcount envelope if approvals are greenlit this week.

Comp bands & ask
- I’ve attached the comp-band benchmarks and a headcount plan spreadsheet. Please review the suggested midpoint and the max offer we should approve without director sign-off:
  - Senior Runtime Engineer (L5): target base midpoint $220k, top-of-band $275k
  - Reliability Eng Lead (L6): target base midpoint $270k, top-of-band $330k

Specific asks
1) Approve the three headcount slots (two L5, one L6) so we can kick off reqs with Recruiting.
2) Confirm comp-band ceilings we can auto-offer (no director escalation) vs offers requiring exec approval.
3) Any objections to the interview panel I suggested (see sheet)?

I’ll start outreach to TalentOps and our priority candidates once I have approvals. If helpful, happy to jump on a 30m to walk through the sheet.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp-band-benchmarks-Q4-2026.pdf, rte-roles-headcount-plan.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, TalentOps Recruiting <hiring-ops@talentco.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime hiring plan + comp band review (Q4 commit)

Thanks Rishi — good clear ask. A couple of quick items I need before I sign off: 

1) Benchmark detail: the PDF is helpful but can you call out comp mix (base / bonus / equity) by role? Recruiting needs that to model total offer.
2) Candidate velocity: do you have any priority prospects (internal referrals or active candidates) you want Recruiting to approach first? If we’re above midpoint for a must-win candidate, we should document it.
3) Approval matrix: please propose the exact numeric thresholds for auto-approved offers (e.g., base <= $X and equity <= Y%), and which level triggers Director/VP approval.

Looped in Hiring Ops — @hiring-ops, please hold the reqs in draft until Rishi provides comp mix and velocity notes.

If it helps, I can approve the two L5 slots today pending a numeric threshold. The L6 ask looks like it may need a brief take from Finance if we’re above 320k total cash.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: TalentOps Recruiting <hiring-ops@talentco.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime hiring plan + comp band review (Q4 commit)

Hi Laura / Rishi —

Attached is a quick benchmarking packet we pulled for L5/L6 infra/runtime roles in the Bay Area and remote-eligible bands. Highlights:
- Median base (remote-adjusted): L5 $205k, L6 $260k
- Typical sign-on bonus: 5-10% for top candidates
- Typical equity: L5 0.12-0.25%, L6 0.25-0.45% (4yr)

We also prepared recommended auto-approve thresholds that map to your ask:
- L5: base <= $235k AND equity <= 0.20% -> Recruiting can extend offers without Director sign-off.
- L6: base <= $300k AND equity <= 0.40% -> requires Director sign-off; anything above needs VP/Finance.

Attachments: comp-band-benchmarks-Q4-2026.pdf, offer-template-runtime.docx

We’ve flagged three active prospects (internal referral, two inbound from job board). Rishi — we can surface candidate profiles if you want immediate outreach.

Cheers,
Sonia Patel
Senior Talent Partner
TalentOps Recruiting

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Runtime hiring plan + comp band review (Q4 commit)

Rishi / Laura — I’m largely supportive. Quick notes:

- Approve 2 x L5 slots to move forward with Recruiting. Recommend we prioritize one candidate with kernel/attention-ops background — offer at up to the auto-approve threshold if needed.
- For the L6 Reliability Lead: I agree with Sonia’s suggested threshold. If we need to go higher than base $300k or equity 0.40%, escalate to me and I’ll take to VP/Finance.

Small ask: please add a column in the spreadsheet for "criticality" (high / medium / low) so we prioritize pipeline if multiple candidates accept concurrently. Also include expected ramp date.

Thanks everyone — consolidating and moving to action: 

Decisions (final)
- Greenlight: 2 x L5 Senior Runtime Engineers. Recruiting to extend offers up to base $235k + equity up to 0.20% without director escalation.
- Conditional greenlight: 1 x L6 Reliability Eng Lead. Recruiting may prepare offer up to base $300k + equity 0.40%, but any ask above those numbers will be sent to Jonas for VP/Finance approval.

Next steps
- Rishi to flag top 3 prospects to TalentOps by EOD tomorrow and mark criticality/ramp date in the sheet.
- Hiring Ops to create reqs and queue offers; use offer-template-runtime.docx.
- Jonas to approve any exceptions above thresholds.

I updated the headcount sheet and added the criticality + ramp columns. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RtE_Runtime_Hiring_Q4

If there’s no objection by EOD Tuesday I’ll mark these slots as committed and push to Recruiting.

— Rishi
